scope: Artifact template and deferred image-body acceptance through Oops; restored nil on rebuild emission rejection; complete core and mapped/rebuilt Method-binding checks

regression_before.failure: Rebuild body demand returned the source-emission Error object instead of the retained nil rejection result.

pre_oop_baseline.adjustment: Copied the installed pre-Oop test and support into a temporary probe crate; adjusted include_bytes paths because installed source excludes the portable fixture. Test logic is unchanged.

retained_checks: Synchronous and resumable artifact bodies execute from one supplied unit with source emission disabled; sixteen independent bindings and live construction/refusal/reentry remain.
Named image templates use current constructors; equal-arity choices remain distinct when their selected objects differ. Staging alone retains selected templates; cancellation releases them.

Body demand performs no eager mapping, observes current emission/loading callbacks, rejects nested cancellation, retains exact loader/initializer Errors and native failures, and retries without caching failed results.
Successful body demands reuse the same Method; the other disposition remains independent. Returned Methods retain code after cancellation; releasing them returns native units to the starting count.
Corrupt body object data is rejected on demand, repeatedly, without source fallback or leaking a mapping.
representation_adjustments: Named bindings share declared Codegen entries and no longer require separate C adapter units. Tests observe current constructor selection and Oop lifetimes instead of obsolete adapter-object emission/coalescing. Historical activation measurement labels remain compatible with supplied-template-bench.py.
qualification_limit: Staged-runtime evidence. Full latest cold-installation qualification and other native/compiler harness migrations remain pending. Native timing lines and different metric configurations do not establish a performance regression percentage.
